    27	  | .add a b _ => max (depth a) (depth b) + 1

    40	  | leaf x => simp [terms, leaves]

    53	end Tree

    57	def level (err : ℕ → ℝ) (ts : List Tree) : List Tree :=

    59	  ((ts.take m).zipIdx).map fun (a, k) =>

    61	    | some b => .add a b (err k)
    62	    | none => a
    63	
    64	/-- Execute exactly the paper's ceiling-logarithm number of levels. -/

    99	      field_simp

   130	      · exact ih a hk' hdepth.1 ha q hq
   131	      · exact ih b hk' hdepth.2 hb q hq
   132

   145	    apply List.map_congr_left
   146	    intro p hp
   147	    dsimp
   148	    ring
   149	  · intro p hp
